name: Every Board Cell Has A Name A Screen Reader Can Say
note: D47 (2026-11-06): the accessibility tree Chrome computes — what TalkBack reads.

mutations.name: the cells lose their names
mutations.why: TalkBack reads 39 empty cells of a Lv.2 board as "button" and a filled one as its digit with no place (stability round 3).
mutations.find: aria-label={cellLabel(t, { r, c, value, given: isInitial, notes: cellNotes, cageSum: killer ? cages[killer.cageOf[cell]]?.sum : undefined })}
mutations.expectFailure: buttons without a name on the game screen

mutations.name: killer cells do not say their cage sum
mutations.why: The sum is drawn on one corner of the cage; a screen-reader player on any other cell of it never hears it.

mutations.name: a given digit sounds like an entered one
mutations.why: The player cannot tell what the puzzle gave from what they wrote — what can be erased from what cannot.

mutations.name: restart loses its name when it becomes an icon
mutations.why: In a short window the words are hidden (D44); without aria-label the button is nameless.
mutations.expectFailure: restart / new game without a name
